title: In-Person Learning
intro:
We offer over 100 unique workshops each year. Our faculty represents some of the most accomplished and innovative practitioners in their fields.

Are you interested in a private tutorial? Email us via info@penumbrafoundation.org or call us at 917-288–0343

If your desired tuition option says “Sold Out” please contact us and we will do our best to accommodate you. If the entire class is sold out, we can add you to the waitlist.

Penumbra is unable to offer scholarships or financial aid.

Please review our education policies before registering!
